relationships.relation_statement: Irreducible plane curves of degree 4 and geometric genus 1 through 12 general points.
relationships.inheritance_policy: Only explicitly recorded source specializations are inherited.

relationships.relation_statement: Set d=4 and delta=2; the genus formula g=(d-1)(d-2)/2-delta gives g=1, and d(d+3)/2-delta=12 point conditions. The generic irreducible genus-1 curves through these general points have exactly 2 ordinary nodes and no other singularities.
relationships.inheritance_policy: Only generic point-constrained enumerative statements with the same irreducibility convention transfer; no equivalence of singularity strata over special point configurations is asserted.
relationships.caveats: Genus alone does not imply nodality for a special curve. This identifies the enumerative problem over general point configurations, where the counted curves lie in the ordinary nodal locus.
